title: Trade Response
description: The target team's reply to a trade-offer.json (PLAN.md §4 step 5: the target agent gets one accept/reject/counter; the offerer then gets final accept/reject on a counter).

response.description: accept/reject the offer as-is, or counter with a new offer.

counter.description: Required when response is 'counter'; shaped like trade-offer.json ({to_team, out, in, message?}) but 'to_team' is implicitly the original offerer.

message.description: Optional in-character note attached to the response.
